text: Mastercard, title partner on the McLaren front, is Mastercard Incorporated (NYSE: MA), a Delaware corporation with a fully dispersed public float; its 10-K notes the Mastercard Foundation's substantial stock ownership as a governance feature, but the Foundation is a private charitable body, not a state. No state stake. Human-rights relevance: payments/fintech conduct and its football sponsorship estate.
